QuestInfo.name: Chiefs of El Nath
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Find Kyrin, the Pirate Job Instructor, and see what advice she has.
QuestInfo.1: Kyrin sent you to the Chief's Residence in El Nath to become an even stronger Pirate.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Pedro, the Pirate Elder, at the Chief's Residence.
